files_modified.purpose: Added the mocktail dev dependency required for interface-based BLoC unit testing.
Added AuthBloc unit tests covering login success, login failure, no-role selection, forgot-password success, and sign-out transitions with mocked dependencies.
Added ArtistDashboardBloc unit tests covering successful and failed track-loading state transitions with a mocked artist repository.
Added OnboardingAiBloc unit tests covering successful and failed biography generation with a mocked AI content service.

summary: Added focused application-layer BLoC unit tests under test/application for AuthBloc, ArtistDashboardBloc, and OnboardingAiBloc using mocked interface dependencies only. No production behavior, repository logic, routing, DI design, or UI code was changed.
test_coverage: AuthBloc: loading -> authenticated on successful login when the fetched user has a completed profile and valid role.
AuthBloc: loading -> error on failed login with current error-message mapping preserved.
AuthBloc: loading -> needsRoleSelection on successful login when the fetched user has no role.
AuthBloc: loading -> forgotPasswordEmailSent on successful forgot-password request.
AuthBloc: loading -> unauthenticated on successful sign-out.
ArtistDashboardBloc: loading -> loaded state when artist and tracks are fetched successfully.
ArtistDashboardBloc: loading -> error state when artist/track fetch fails.
OnboardingAiBloc: loading -> generated bio on successful biography generation.
OnboardingAiBloc: loading -> error state on biography generation failure.
notes: OnboardingAiBloc is present and was testable with the current IAiContentService interface, so both success and failure paths were covered.
mocktail was added successfully and all tests use mocked interface types rather than concrete implementations.

bloc_test could not be added in this repository without causing pub resolution failure due to an existing dependency conflict involving firebase_ai, flutter_test, and the pinned auto_route_generator range; the tests were implemented with flutter_test stream assertions instead so ST-007 remains validated without production changes.
validation_checks: Confirmed: added tests compile and run against mocked dependencies only
Confirmed: no production-layer files under lib/ were modified for this step
